verdict.rationale: Bento's marketing says releases are scored against production history "offline, in CI," and the CLI is usable from CI, so CI-time scoring is a first-party claim. However, no doc shows how to run an eval from CI, define pass/fail thresholds, or block a deploy on the result. The "catches regressions before users do" line only implies gating. Missing for 10: documented CI eval command or integration, deployment gating mechanism (exit codes or thresholds), eval/dataset configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results

citations.quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic. Catches regressions before users do.
Anything you can do in the dashboard, you can do from your terminal, a script, or CI
